claims.claim: Managed PCC access requires App Store Small Business Program enrollment, fewer than two million first-time App Store downloads for any individual app, and an assigned entitlement; this is not a combined portfolio-download threshold. Testing installs are excluded. If an app subsequently exceeds the threshold or enrollment ends, Apple notifies the developer and requires migration to an alternative within six months.
claims.locator: Eligibility requirements and subsequent threshold/enrollment-loss paragraph
claims.release_qualifier: Conditional developer service access; neither SDK availability nor a no-cloud-API-cost offer establishes eligibility
